description.text: Two boys asleep in one bed with their heads at opposite ends, and their father still up, mending a net he could mend blind. A woman's shawl hangs on the door peg where it has hung for four years and will go on hanging.

A cottage that smells permanently of river and pitch. Nets hang the length of one wall in various states of repair, floats and lead in a bowl, and every boot in the house is wet. Someone has scratched six fish onto the doorframe with names beside them; the largest is labelled, in careful letters, THE REEVE.

options.text: Step back out to the bank
